The '''Western Rakata Transporter''' was the name given to the [[Rakata/Legends|Rakata]] transporter uncovered in the western reaches of the [[High Security Section]] on the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Belsavis/Legends|Belsavis]]. Located in a cave on the south side of the [[Alien Gangland]] area, it was controlled by the [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Galactic Republic]].<ref name="TOR" />
